name: Be thui Cau Mong
summary: Bê thui Cầu Mống is the plate that shared the night program in Thôn Mỹ Sơn with mì Quảng on 24 Mar 2022.
origin: Thôn Mỹ Sơn, at the night program of 24 Mar 2022.
where: The program began at 16:00 on 24 Mar 2022 in Thôn Mỹ Sơn, xã Duy Phú. On 1 Dec 2025 Tuổi Trẻ quotes the deputy in charge saying the night calendar is not fixed.
The ticket rules forbid eating in the monument area.
Thịt nghé, in the sanctuary essay, is a separate specialty.
seoTitle: Be thui Cau Mong — the plate at one My Son night
seoDescription: Bê thui Cầu Mống shared the 24 Mar 2022 night program in Thôn Mỹ Sơn with mì Quảng. The night calendar is not fixed.
